content.title: Free MLB.TV Subscription: Stream Live Baseball Games | T-Mobile
content.text: To redeem the benefit, T-Mobile and Metro by T-Mobile qualifying customers must: Android Users: 1. Install (if not already) and open the T-Life app or myMetro app. a. After an install, user will need to sign into the app using their T-Mobile or Metro by T-Mobile phone number. 2. Starting Tuesday, March 24, 2026, from 5:00 AM ET through Tuesday, March 31, 2026, at 4:59 AM ET: a. Click on the MLB.TV tile in the T-Life app or myMetro app, which will take you to the detail page. i. You may need to navigate to Benefits tab (T-Mobile customers) or Tuesdays (Metro customers). b. Click “SAVE”, which will take you to the redemption page. c. Click “REDEEM”, which will take you to MLB.com’s MLB.TV registration page, specifically for this T-Mobile benefit (you will not be asked to pay). d. If you already have a MLB.com account, you will be directed to the “Returning Customers” page. Enter your username and password and click “Login”. e. If you do not have a MLB.com account, you will be directed to the “Register” page. Enter the required fields and click “Register”. f. You will then be routed to the confirmation page. g. Click “WATCH NOW” to enjoy your free MLB.TV subscription! iOS Users: 1. You must have the 18.0 or later version of the MLB app installed first on your device to access the redemption link. If you do not have the MLB App, please visit the App Store to download the MLB app. After you have downloaded the app, return to the T-Life app or myMetro app to redeem your free subscription. 2. Install (if not already) and open the T-Life app or myMetro app. After an install, user will need to sign into the app using their T-Mobile or Metro by T-Mobile phone number. 3. Starting Tuesday, March 24, 2026, from 5:00 AM ET through Tuesday, March 31, 2026, at 4:59 AM ET: a. Click on the MLB.TV tile in the T-Life app, which will take you to the detail page. i. You may need to navigate to Benefits tab (T-Mobile customers) or Tuesdays tab (Metro customers). b. Click “SAVE”, which will take you to the MLB.TV redemption page. c. Click “REDEEM”. i. If you have not yet downloaded the compatible MLB app, you will be prompted to download the app (the app download will be free). Tap “Download on the App Store” to download or update to the latest version of the MLB app. ii. If you have downloaded the compatible app, you will be taken to the MLB app. d. Click “REDEEM NOW” which will prompt a free Apple Pay purchase to redeem the free MLB.TV subscription. i. If user does not have a CC in their iTunes account, they will be required to add one, but the CC will not be charged. e. Confirm free Apple Pay for MLB.TV for T-Mobile app. f. If you already have a MLB.com account, you will be directed to the “Returning Customers” page. Enter your username and password and click “Login”. g. If you do not have a MLB.com account, you will be directed to the “Register” page. Enter the required fields and click “Register”. h. You will then be routed to the confirmation page. i. Click “WATCH NOW” to enjoy your free MLB.TV subscription! Note: Ensure in-app purchases are enabled in settings prior to redeeming.
